cast.name: Department of Homeland Security
cast.evidence: The speaker repeatedly cites findings from the 'Department of Homeland Security', and the on-screen text states 'DHS has identified 250,000 non-citizens'.

on_screen_text.text: Sec. Mullin announces DHS has identified 250,000 non-citizens registered to vote accross four states

spoken_summary: Markwayne Mullin states that the Department of Homeland Security has identified 250,000 non-citizens registered to vote across four states: California, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and Nevada. He emphasizes this is from only four states, and repeats the figure. He also mentions that in other 'proactive states', 28,000 non-citizens were found on voter rolls, in addition to 400,000 deceased individuals who are still registered to vote.
audio_music: The audio consists only of Markwayne Mullin's speaking voice, with the natural room acoustics of a press conference. There is no music or other sound design.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot of a talking head at a podium. There are no cuts or camera movements.
central_claim: The Department of Homeland Security has discovered hundreds of thousands of improperly registered voters, including non-citizens and deceased people, indicating a major threat to election security.
intended_effect: To raise alarm about the integrity of US elections and create support for stricter voter roll maintenance and security measures.
